units.source_text: 春天和煦的斜阳柔和地照在招牌的旧金字上，反而给人一种寂寞的感觉。

en.t: The warm slanting sunlight of spring shone softly on the old gold lettering of the signboard, but somehow it gave an even lonelier feeling.

units.source_text: 店铺那幅厚布门帘，也已经褪色发白，露出了粗缝线来。

en.t: The shop's heavy cloth curtain had also faded whitish, exposing its coarse stitching.
